paper_metadata.title: Microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of TLP bonded joints of Mar-M247 superalloys with Ni-Cr-Co-W-Ta-B interlayer

evidence.quote: The three-stage isothermal solidification process of TLP bonded Mar-M247 nickel-based superalloy was studied.
The thickness of the Ni-Cr-Co-W-Ta-B amorphous foil was 50 /H9262m.
